evidence.evidence_text: In light of this, we propose R-VC, a rhythm-controllable and efficient zero-shot voice conversion model.
R-VC employs data perturbation techniques and discretize source speech into Hubert content tokens, eliminating much content-irrelevant information.

Furthermore, R-VC introduces a powerful Diffusion Transformer (DiT) with shortcut flow matching during training, conditioning the network not only on the current noise level but also on the desired step size, enabling high timbre similarity and quality speech generation in fewer sampling steps, even in just two, thus minimizing latency.
